args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (error rate 18%) following its deploy. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification: all regions healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate 0.2%. Note: v2.3.1-rc was only ever healthy in staging, so it was not a valid rollback target.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release healthy in production. I deliberately did not use v2.3.1-rc since it was only ever healthy in staging.
3. **Verified**: all regions are now healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate back to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
